name: v72_defined_contribution_cost_relief
hypothesis: Lower defined-contribution plan cost relative to assets may proxy lower recurring labor-benefit burden without using the stopped stock-compensation or employee-liability fields.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * recognized_cost_defined_contribution_plan / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(recognized_cost_defined_contribution_plan / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 126), industry)
notes: Clean high-coverage footnote not directly tested; abandon if it maps to employee/SBP accounting-cleanliness actives.

name: v72_new_stock_issuance_pressure
